mostWorthwhile.text: Making the antibody-producing and memory cells was most worthwhile: it showed how one matching cell can produce descendants with different jobs.

leastWorthwhile.text: Making antibodies from amino acids felt fairly predictable after learning that antibodies are proteins, though it connected to the earlier protein-building chapter.
